messages:
incident-bot: PAGING: spike in 5xx and gateway timeouts in us-west-2 beginning ~T-5m. Notable cross-region retries into eu-west-1. Oncall: @Diego M.
Diego M: Ack. Looking at global error dashboard. Which services are producing most 5xx?
Hannah L: Gateway shows increased 502/504 across /v1/generate and /v1/stream endpoints. Error signature: `upstream reset by peer` and `read timeout`.
Zoe W: I can see a sudden surge of large streaming sessions from a partner (TranscribeNow) about the same time — long-lived connections + bursts.
infra-bot: autoscaler: scaling event detected for asg-usw2-inference at 2018002400 (scale up +4 nodes).
Diego M: Any recent deploys in the last 15m?
deploy-bot: deploy: connection-pool-fix rolled to us-west-2 at 2018002345 by ci/cd.
Hannah L: That deploy adjusted max_sockets and keepalive settings. Could be related. Logs show sockets in CLOSE_WAIT accumulating and accept queue saturation.
Zoe W: I'm seeing a pattern where when a node hits the accept backlog, upstream resets happen and gateway retries, which then spill to eu-west-1 due to our failover policy. eu-west-1 then sees a small bump and struggles to absorb it.
Diego M: Immediate plan: 1) Throttle partner traffic from TranscribeNow by applying a per-customer rate cap in the gateway. 2) Temporarily disable cross-region auto-failover for us-west-2 to avoid flash-shifting load. 3) Scale inference pool more aggressively. 4) Add fast-fail circuit breaker for overloaded backends. Who can do the gateway throttle?
Hannah L: Pushing a throttle rule: `throttle: client_id=transcribenow, rate=150rps, burst=300` now.
Zoe W: Disabling cross-region auto-failover for us-west-2 now. New sessions will not be sent to eu-west-1 as fallback. Existing sticky sessions unaffected.
Diego M: Scaling: bumping replicas of inference-deployment-usw2 from 20 -> 28 and requesting +3 GPU nodes from cloud. Running `kubectl scale --replicas=28 -n inference inference-deployment-usw2`.
infra-bot: cloud: requested 3 extra GPU nodes in us-west-2 ASG, expected ~5m provisioning.
Hannah L: Also lowering gateway keepalive from 120s -> 30s and socket backlog from 1024 -> 512 to alleviate fd pressure. Patch applied.
Zoe W: Adding circuit breaker: `consecutive_failures=6, open_ms=30000, probe_rps=2` for the inference upstream in us-west-2.
Diego M: Any early impact on error rates?
Hannah L: 5xx for us-west-2 down from 20% -> 8% in last 90s. eu-west-1 leveling off since we turned off failover.
Zoe W: Noted that some batch embedding jobs for Searchly were retried into eu-west-1 earlier and are queued. I'll schedule a controlled replay to fallback pool to avoid sudden spikes.
ops-comm: Drafting customer comms now. Notifying TranscribeNow and Searchly of mitigation steps and ETA for full stability.
Diego M: Quick check: are there OOMs or pod restarts?
Hannah L: No OOMs. A few pods show high `fd` usage; we've rotated them and restarted the worst offenders.
Zoe W: Pulling a live tcpdump on one node shows many FIN/ACK from app side, indicating improper socket close handling in the new connection-pool-fix under load.
Diego M: OK, if connection-pool-fix looks suspect, prepare to roll back that config for us-west-2 after stabilization. We'll keep the throttle and circuit-breaker.
Hannah L: Rolling back the connection-pool flag for us-west-2 canary now: flipping `connection_pool.max_sockets` to previous value. Patch applied.
Diego M: Good. Any customer-visible degradation left?
ops-comm: Customer impact: TranscribeNow experienced partial transcript gaps for ~6% of long sessions between T-6m and T-2m. Searchly batch jobs delayed ~10-25m. Internal jobs requeued. Communications sent.
Zoe W: After rollback + scale + throttle, 5xx is now ~1.6% region-wide and p95 latencies are within normal thresholds. No new restarts in last 6m.
Hannah L: I'll keep the socket backlog and keepalive adjustments for 30m, then revert if stable. Also scheduling a follow-up test harness to load test connection_pool changes.
Diego M: Post-incident actions to track: 1) Reproduce connection-pool behavior under long-stream load in staging. 2) Add per-customer rate-limits and automatic throttling for very large streams. 3) Change failover to include a rate cap to avoid flash-shifting. 4) Improve canary gate for network/socket-affecting changes.
incident-bot: Incident state: mitigated (partial). Please assign RCA and timeline.
Diego M: I'll own the postmortem. Zoe, Hannah please co-author. I'll create the timeline and link the incident doc.
pager: Severity: Sev2 partial regional degradation. Postmortem owner: Diego M.
ops-comm: Final customer note queued. We'll send follow-up with RCA after investigation.
Zoe W: Filing follow-ups: TASK-5522 (conn-pool-stress), TASK-5523 (failover-rate-cap), TASK-5524 (per-customer-throttle). Links will be posted.
Hannah L: Handing off monitoring to oncall Jacob in 20m. Leaving alerting thresholds slightly lowered for the next hour.
Diego M: Thanks team. If stable for 30m we'll clear pager. :white_check_mark:
ops-comm: Final summary will be posted to incidents channel and customer ops.
